modern: Get into the habit, as far as possible, whenever anything is done by anyone, of asking yourself: For what purpose is this man doing this? But begin with yourself, and examine yourself first.
original: Accustom thyself as much as possible on the occasion of anything being done by any person to inquire with thyself, For what object is this man doing this? But begin with thyself, and examine thyself first.

explained.summary: Whenever anyone does something, get into the habit of asking what they’re trying to achieve by it. But start with yourself, and examine your own motives first. Asking about others helps you understand them; asking about yourself keeps you honest about why you do what you do.
explained.today: Before firing off the email, posting the photo or volunteering for the high-profile project, ask why. Sometimes the honest answer is to look good, and noticing that is half the work.
